key_quotes.quote: Then you can sell them by the board foot to woodworkers, to wood enthusiasts.

claims.claim: The speaker says a portable sawmill operator can be hired for about $60 an hour.
claims.quote: You can actually make a lot of money from this wood if you pay someone about 60 bucks an hour to come here, slice it all up for you, and then you just let it sit.

acquisition_channels.details: Sell to woodworkers, wood enthusiasts or barbecue users

ideas.delivery: Obtain logs, hire a portable sawmill operator, stack and season slabs, then sell.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Check timber transport and treatment rules, workplace safety and any duties for selling wood fuel.

idea.name: Buy and resell or dropship decomposed granite
idea.one_liner: Source decomposed granite cheaply from quarries, then sell it through paid leads or local stock.

idea.offer: Decomposed granite delivered or available for pickup

key_quotes.quote: So, what you can do is you can use Replit or Lindy to make a lead format, you can push paid ads to it and just play middleman.

claims.claim: The speaker says Living Earth sells for about $50 to $70 a cubic yard and a quarry in Oklahoma for about $20 a yard.
claims.quote: I think they sell it for like 50 to 70 dollars a yard, a cubic yard. But if you buy directly from the quarry in Oklahoma, it's about 20 dollars a yard.

claims.claim: The speaker says his truckload cost a few hundred dollars.
claims.quote: Now, I spent a few hundred dollars for a whole truckload of this stuff and I clearly haven't used it yet.

acquisition_channels.details: Drive paid traffic to a lead form built with Replit or Lindy
Resell stock for local pickup or act as a middleman

ideas.delivery: Source aggregate from a quarry, then arrange pickup or delivery; alternatively hold stock on land.

prices: A few hundred dollars per truckload

ideas.other_uk_rules: Check consumer pricing, product descriptions, transport permits and health-and-safety rules for bulk aggregate handling.

idea.name: Rent out a hydraulic log splitter
idea.one_liner: Rent a log splitter to people who have cut trees but do not want to buy one.
idea.offer: Daily rental of a hydraulic splitter

key_quotes.quote: If you can't find enough customers as a firewood business, you can rent this thing out for about 80 to 90 dollars a day on Facebook Marketplace, cuz people cut down trees, they want to convert it into firewood, but they have no need to buy a $1,500 splitter.

claims.claim: The speaker paid $1,500 for the splitter and suggests renting it for $80 to $90 a day.
claims.quote: If you can't find enough customers as a firewood business, you can rent this thing out for about 80 to 90 dollars a day on Facebook Marketplace, cuz people cut down trees, they want to convert it into firewood, but they have no need to buy a $1,500 splitter.

ideas.delivery: Store, maintain and hand off or deliver the splitter to renters.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Use a clear equipment-hire agreement, insurance and safety instructions; check UK product-safety and liability duties.

idea.name: Septic-tank repair or installation
idea.one_liner: Start or buy a septic business repairing or installing septic systems.
idea.offer: Septic-system repair or installation

key_quotes.quote: So, the takeaway here, start or buy a septic tank repair or installation business.

claims.claim: The speaker cites net profit margins of 20% to 40% for septic businesses.
claims.quote: They're dirty, it's unsexy, nobody wants to get into it, but the net profit margins are 20 to 40% because no one wants to get into it.

claims.claim: The speaker says contractors quoted him $15,000 for a replacement system.
claims.quote: All I wanted to do was add a simple bathroom to my shop, and I knew that this could be fixed because it was working when the mobile home was here, and they all said, "Nope, you need a new system, $15,000, $15,000."

ideas.delivery: Send a septic technician to diagnose, repair or install systems at customer properties.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Check UK environmental permits, drainage and building regulations, waste handling and operator qualifications.

idea.name: Broker mature-tree relocation
idea.one_liner: Match landowners clearing mature trees with buyers and arrange tree-spade removal and delivery.
idea.customer: Landowners clearing land and buyers wanting mature trees
idea.offer: Find, transplant and transport mature trees
idea.revenue_model: Brokerage spread or tree-spade service fees

key_quotes.quote: There is a big business between playing middleman between the forestry mulchers, the land clearers, the tree trimming companies, and the people that own what's called a tree spade.

claims.claim: The speaker says a mature tree of this size could cost a couple thousand dollars at a tree farm.
claims.quote: If I were to go to a tree farm, this is about as big as they'll sell them, and this is going to cost a couple thousand dollars.

claims.claim: The example contrasts a buyer paying $2,500 with a possible $1,000 price and says a broker can keep the spread.
claims.quote: Maybe they don't want to pay $2,500 for it, maybe they want to pay $1,000 for it, and you can take the spread between those two parties.

claims.claim: A tree spade costs about $4,000.
claims.quote: You could actually own the spade, they cost about $4,000, or you could just find a guy that has one, you play middleman, he does all the work, you or him deliver it, and we don't have to cut down as many trees.

acquisition_channels.details: Connect land clearers, tree-trimming companies and tree-spade owners with tree buyers

ideas.delivery: Arrange a tree spade, pot the tree and coordinate truck transport to the buyer.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Check tree-preservation orders, planning, transport and insurance requirements for mature-tree relocation.

stated_problem.quote: That road, which is closer to my house, does not have fiber.

idea.name: Rural fiber installation and internet service

idea.revenue_model: Not stated; the speaker describes customers as long-lasting

ideas.delivery: Install fiber along routes, connect homes and operate an internet service.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Check Ofcom communications-provider obligations, wayleave and street-works permissions, planning and UK GDPR for customer data.

idea.name: Rent ditch witches or trenchers

idea.name: Lake and pond weed removal
idea.one_liner: Remove weeds and debris from private ponds and lakes, starting with manual raking and scaling to machinery.

key_quotes.quote: Their whole sales pitch was, "We don't use chemicals. It's all natural." They started this business.

claims.claim: The speaker says the students' business makes six figures a year.

claims.quote: Then, you just reach out to them and say, "Hey, I bet you no one's ever offered to clean your pond or your lake before. I'll do that." You can charge hundreds of dollars per hour.

acquisition_channels.details: Use third-party property tools and databases to find lake or pond owners, then reach out

ideas.other_uk_rules: Check pool safety, public liability, access, insurance and any local planning or operating requirements.
